demos.name: AI assistant to MCP authorization flow LAB
demos.description: How a remote MCP server behind an enterprise front door is authorized when a public AI assistant calls it for a signed-in user: connector catalog, PKCE, resource indicators, IdP hand-off, RFC 8693 exchange. 20 messages backed by real mock exchanges. Mock only; product claims UNVERIFIED.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm ci && npm run build && npm start (port 6650; mock actors on 6651-6655, MCP_FLOW_STUB_BASE moves them; npm run doctor checks it). Docker: HOST_PORT=6650 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock only; Live is refused. Catalog id D25 is carried over from the old repo and is still a placeholder (to confirm).
